name: CVR(T) Scimitar / Spartan family
armament: Scimitar: 30 mm RARDEN cannon + 7.62 mm coaxial GPMG
protection: Aluminium armour, light. Game: immune to 5.56/5.45/7.62x39/7.62x51; 7.62x54R and larger can penetrate side/rear and disable wheels, engine and optics; every launcher in the game list penetrates.
visual_notes: Very small low tracked vehicle, five road wheels per side, front drive sprocket
Scimitar: small two-man turret with a slim 30 mm gun; Spartan: taller box troop body, no turret
Sultan/Samaritan: high box roof, Samaritan with red-cross panels
Latvian vehicles in NATO green or Latvian camouflage
